method: Xiaohongshu search on 「体检报告 看不懂」 (logged-in browser; the result list and like counts are only visible in a screenshot, not in page text). Opened the highest-engagement note and scrolled the comment panel, reading comments off screenshots. Quotes verbatim in the original Chinese with province and relative date as displayed 2026-08-06. Updated 2026-08-06: the third voice had been carried over as a paraphrase from an earlier sweep; it has now been replaced with the verbatim comment text (author + like count) read out of the note's own page state, and two further verbatim comments from the same 763-like/214-comment note were added.
gap: The two sides never meet. Check-up products stop at translating the report into plain language; diet-logging products count calories and have never seen your lab sheet. The most-repeated request in Chinese comment sections is precisely the join — log what I eat and read it against my check-up — and the consensus about the incumbents (薄荷 / Cal AI / Caloris) is that they cover too little.

zh.pain: 拿到体检报告，几个数字标红。医生三句话打发你，回家越查越怕——于是你跑到陌生医生的科普视频底下，把自己的化验值一条条贴出来，求他看一眼。
zh.kill: 健康建议的责任边界很硬——说重了吓人，说轻了担责；这条线走不好，一次误判就毁掉全部信任。
zh.move: 只做「翻译」不做「诊断」：把一张报告变成人话，标出哪几个数值真的该去医院、该挂哪一科，其余的说清楚为什么不用慌。
zh.hook: 一个拿着体检报告、三项飘红的成年人——他已经把自己的化验值贴在陌生人的视频底下，求对方替他看一眼。

pain: A cardiac surgeon's 30-second explainer on four blood-test numbers has 16k likes, 35k saves and 194 comments on Xiaohongshu — and the comments are not thanks. They are ordinary people pasting their own values and asking a stranger to read them. Under the same query what ranks is a how-to for getting an LLM to read your report, not a product.
kill: This is health advice with a thin line under it, and the line is where the value is: the moment it says 'eat this' it is one step from dosing supplements and two from telling someone to skip a doctor. The honest version is deliberately smaller than the exciting version. Chinese super-apps and the check-up chains themselves already sit on the report at the moment of delivery, and diet-logging retention is famously awful — people log for eleven days.
move: Do not build a health app. Build one artefact from one document: lipid panel plus fasting glucose in, a week's grocery list and a one-swap-a-day table out, with 'this is not a diagnosis — take abnormal values to a doctor' fixed at the bottom. No wearables, no long-term tracking, no medication. Cold start (Chinese): the 194 comments under that one note are already a list of named people asking, plus the 「体检报告 看不懂」 and 「怎么让AI解读体检报告」 queries; (English): r/Biohackers and r/nutrition threads where someone posts bloodwork and asks what to eat differently.
hook: An adult holding an annual check-up with three values in red, who has already pasted those values under a stranger's video and asked him to read them.
